 Drop Shock Test Instrument
 DT-202/DT-202TB/202AW
DROP TOWER DT-202 series
Drop Tester for Mobile Products DT-202, 202TB, 202AW
DROP TESTER for Mobile Products such as smart phone, wearable device, tablet, laptop.
DT-202 is a standard model of drop tester that provides accurate drop tests via a unique drop mechanism for smart phones, wearable devices such as fitness tracker or smartwatch, components, medicine, and other mobile products. The specimen holding system retains dropping attitude, enabling it to provide drop tests superior in reproducibility.
DT-202TB is a wider sized drop tester. Its application is not only limited to the testing of mobile phones, but also extends to a broader variety of products such as laptop PC, tablet device, HDD, battery, medical devices, foods, wearable devices such as glasses etc. These testers are CE certified. 
 Rutgers University professors reviewed DT-202
